```lean
intro x
let S := LieSubalgebra.engel K x
have hS : LieSubalgebra K S := by apply LieSubalgebra.closure_self
have hF : FiniteDimensional K ↥S := by apply Module.Finite K L; apply submodule.finite_dimensional_of_finite
let d := Module.finrank K ↥S
let p := LinearMap.charpoly (LieAlgebra.ad K L x)
have hp : NatTrailingDegree p = d := by
  have h1 : (LinearMap.charpoly (LieAlgebra.ad K L x)).natTrailingDegree = Module.finrank K ↥S :=
    by apply (LieAlgebra Engel's theorem).natTrailingDegree_eq_finrank
  rw [h1]
  rfl
exact hp
```
